description: Buddy Phase 11 — Integration Wiring & Self-Diagnostics. Phases 1-10 built 25 modules. Phase 11 connects them: exit reason patterns feed learning engine, agent health drives selective decay in orchestrator, regime-aware agent toggling, macro stress wired to position sizing, online RL in orchestrator loop, QA+gate health into system diagnostics. DIRECTIVE: NEVER STOP. DONT ASK. ONLY ASK WHEN DESTRUCTIVE.

userStories.title: Exit reason learning loop — extract patterns from exit classifications
userStories.description: Wire exit_reason data from trade journal into learning_engine. Extract patterns like 'EUR_USD hits SL 70% of trades → widen SL' or 'trailing_stop exits average 2.3x more pnl_pips than tp_hit'. Feed insights into learnings.md.
acceptanceCriteria: Reads trade_journal_rl.json, groups by exit_reason per pair
Computes: exit_reason distribution, avg pnl_pips per exit_type, pair-specific exit patterns
Generates structured learnings from patterns (e.g., 'SL-hit rate > 60% on pair X → consider widening SL')
userStories.notes: extract_exit_reason_patterns() added to learning_engine.py with 5 pattern rules: SL-hit rate >60%, TP-hit rate >70%, trailing_stop outperforms TP, high timeout rate, breakeven dominance. Wired as Step 5b in orchestrator LEARN phase.

userStories.title: Agent health → orchestrator integration — record outcomes and apply decay
userStories.description: Wire AgentHealthMonitor into orchestrator trade sync. After each closed trade, call record_outcome() with agent verdicts and pair. Selective decay rates flow into weight updates.
acceptanceCriteria: After sync_closed_trades_rl, calls monitor.record_outcome() for each synced trade
Passes agent_verdicts and pair to enable per-pair attribution
userStories.notes: AgentHealthMonitor initialized in _init_modules(). Step 4b calls record_outcome(agent_verdicts, trade_won, pair) for each closed trade. agent_health_report field added to OrchestrationResult.

userStories.title: Regime-aware agent enabling — skip irrelevant agents by volatility regime
userStories.description: Add regime-specific agent toggling. In EXTREME regime, disable mean_reversion and session_timing. In LOW regime, disable volatility agent. Reduces noise in agent consensus.
acceptanceCriteria: _team.py evaluate() skips agents disabled for current regime
Skipped agents logged but don't count toward vote totals
Default config preserves current behavior (no agents disabled)
userStories.notes: regime_disabled_agents added to ScannerConfig with defaults: EXTREME disables mean_reversion+session_timing, LOW disables volatility. _team.py evaluate() filters verdicts post-collection and logs skipped agents. Empty dict preserves backward compatibility.

userStories.title: Macro stress → orchestrator position sizing integration
userStories.description: Wire MacroStressDetector into orchestrator scan loop. Update stress signals each cycle from regime and spread data. Pass stress_modifier into analysis_context for execution.
acceptanceCriteria: Each SCAN cycle calls macro_stress.update() with regime and spread data
stress_modifier passed into analysis_context for trades
userStories.notes: MacroStressDetector initialized in _init_modules(). Step 2b extracts dominant regime via Counter.most_common, averages spread ratios, calls update(). stress_state dict (score, modifier, regime) added to OrchestrationResult.

userStories.title: Online RL micro-updates in orchestrator loop
userStories.description: Wire OnlineWeightUpdater into orchestrator. Call maybe_update() each cycle so agent weights converge faster within sessions without waiting for trade close.
acceptanceCriteria: Doesn't conflict with full RL sync (both can run)
userStories.notes: OnlineWeightUpdater initialized in _init_modules(). Step 2c calls maybe_update(cycle_count) every cycle. Returns List[WeightAdjustment] serialized via asdict into online_rl_update field. Runs independently from full RL sync in Step 4.

userStories.title: QA pipeline + gate health → system diagnostics report
userStories.description: Wire QAPipeline and GateHealthTracker into orchestrator. Run health audit periodically (every 10 cycles). Surface system health as structured report in OrchestrationResult.
acceptanceCriteria: Every 10 cycles runs qa_pipeline.run() and gate_health.get_gate_health()
get_system_health_report() combines QA score + gate health + agent health
Health warnings logged when score drops below threshold
userStories.notes: Both QAPipeline and GateHealthTracker initialized in _init_modules(). _get_system_health_report() combines QA score (normalized 0-100→0-1), gate degradation fraction, and stale agent ratio into overall_score. Runs every 10 cycles via Step 8b. Warning logged when score < 0.6.
